preconditions.description: The dimensions of the land plot must be between 3 and 300 for both rows and columns, and the desired time t must be between 1 and 10^9.
The times for flat ground, ascent, and descent must be between 1 and 100.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= height <= 10**6 for row in heights for height in row)
preconditions.description: All height values in the land plot must be positive integers not exceeding 10^6.

postconditions.description: The output must be four positive integers representing the coordinates of the upper left and lower right corners of the chosen rectangle.

postconditions.expression: abs(ts - t) == min(abs(ts - t) for ts in possible_times)
postconditions.description: The time taken to pass the selected track must be as close to the desired time t as possible.
